messages.content: Return JSON keys hero{eyebrow,title,description}, motionDescription, empty{title,description}. Repair Openline Brand Library copy: Hero should warmly convey one place for everything Openline, rather than stiff 'Official Visual Identity Assets'. Exact supplied brand resources, source files and creative review concepts live together. Title <=7words, description <=28words, no hype/no em dash. Motion description must NOT call all animations approved: original source animation plus review treatments. Empty fields must not be blank: title No matching assets or equivalent; description concise tryanothersearch/resetfilters. English, user-facing no technical jargon.
